boundaries: No guaranteed lead volume beyond delivered batch
No exclusive data ownership claims beyond delivered file
No real-time/ongoing monitoring in this fixed scope
clarification_questions: Duplicate policy vs your existing base?
commercial_proposal.delivery_schedule: Day 1-2: criteria lock + source mapping. Day 3-4: collection + verification. Day 5: QA + delivery. Day 6: one revision round.
commercial_proposal.delivery_scope: One verified lead database per agreed criteria, delivered within the 6-day window

execution.output: CSV/Sheet: agreed fields, deduped, spot-verified sample
execution.process: Define criteria from answers → map public sources → collect → verify sample → QA → deliver
execution.quality_method: Inclusion-rule check per record + random verification sample + dedupe pass

commercial_proposal.input: Buyer answers to clarification set (geography, vertical, size, role, fields, volume)
commercial_proposal.opening: I build verified B2B lead lists to exact criteria — scoped, deduped, and delivered fast. Your 6-day window fits: criteria lock day 1-2, verified delivery by day 5, revision buffer day 6.
commercial_proposal.price_hypothesis: Within buyer range $30-250; scoped quote after clarification answers (volume × verification depth)
commercial_proposal.understanding: You need a high-quality lead database, not a raw scrape: exact titles, verified fields, no duplicates against your base.

founder_gate.account: Freelancer bidding identity (create/authorize) + MFA if prompted
founder_gate.authentication: login owned by founder; factory never touches credentials
founder_gate.delivery_support: none needed (delivery = file handoff via platform)
founder_gate.expected_unlock: bid submission on OPP-FL-LEADGEN-001 within window
founder_gate.legal: platform terms accepted by account owner at signup
founder_gate.maximum_bid_boundary: At or below buyer range midpoint unless volume justifies more; exact figure set after clarification answers
founder_gate.payment_authorization: none (buyer pays on delivery via platform escrow)
founder_gate.what_account: Single Freelancer.com freelancer identity owned by founder
founder_gate.why: bidding requires authenticated human-owned identity; factory cannot create/operate accounts
founder_gate.how_to_submit: Log in to your Freelancer account, open the project URL, paste the prepared proposal text, set bid within boundary, submit. Factory cannot operate your session (no credential handling).

max_risks: Criteria answers may narrow/expand scope beyond 6 days
Budget floor $30 may not cover deep verification — quote accordingly

live_recheck.implication: competition tripled; win-rate declining; time pressure real
